title: Prevent magic item table rows from contaminating names
description: Observed during SRD 5.1 import validation: magic item records such as Armor of Vulnerability and Bead of Force were generated with preceding table rows prefixed into the name/key. Expected parser to keep embedded tables in the previous item description and use only the actual next item name.
notes:
Evidence: scratch import produced 218 magic-item records, but generated keys/names included table-row prefixes such as '1 Acid 6 Necrotic ... Armor of Vulnerability', 'Type Strength Rarity ... Berserker Axe', and '97-00 Portable Ram Rod of Absorption'. The bad values originate before emission: parseMagicItems scans backward from an item category line and treats numeric/table-header description rows as candidate name lines.
Pattern: valid wrapped item names in the focused fixtures use an actual title continuation, e.g. 'Amulet of Proof against Detection and' + 'Location'. Broken rows are body table rows immediately before a new item title; some start with digits ('1 Acid 6 Necrotic') and others are word-led table rows ('Type Strength Rarity', 'Hill giant 21 Rare'), so digit-prefix rejection alone would not address the observed artifacts.
Failing check: npx vitest run packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseMagicItems.test.ts fails before the fix. The parsed names include '1 Acid 6 Necrotic ... Armor of Vulnerability' and 'Type Strength Rarity ... Berserker Axe', and Armor of Resistance's description loses '1 Acid 6 Necrotic' because those body rows became the next entry name.
Hypothesis: body/table rows are entering names because looksLikeNameLine permits lines with ordinary numeric cells or dice/count text. Real SRD magic-item title lines that contain numbers use enhancement notation like '+1', '+2', '+3'. Rejecting title candidates with non-plus-prefixed digits should stop table-row backtracking while preserving '+N' item names and wrapped names.
Result: numeric-row filter removed the contaminated names, but the focused test still fails because 'Belt of Giant Strength' is not parsed. New evidence: category detection requires one of common/uncommon/rare/very rare/legendary/artifact and misses SRD lines that say 'rarity varies'. Additional hypothesis: include 'rarity varies'/'varies' in category detection and continuation without changing emitted rarity text.
Verified focused fix: npx vitest run packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseMagicItems.test.ts now passes, 9 tests. The regression confirms numeric and word-led table rows remain in the previous item description, following item names are clean, and 'rarity varies' category lines are recognized.
Original import verified: npm run import:dnd5e-srd now reports 222 magic items. Generated records inspection found no suspicious magic-item names matching the previous row-prefix patterns; first/last names are clean, e.g. Adamantine Armor through Wings of Flying.
close_reason: Fixed magic item name contamination by rejecting non-enhancement numeric body/table lines as title candidates and recognizing 'rarity varies' category lines; verified with focused parser regression, importer suite, and scratch SRD import/name inspection.
